description: This file defines a generic LRU (Least Recently Used) cache implementation with TTL (Time To Live) support, including cache management methods and static cache control features.

classes.name: LRUCache
classes.description: A generic, thread-safe LRU cache with TTL support, capable of managing multiple cache instances and providing cache control functionalities.

methods.name: allCachesEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables all cache instances globally.

methods.name: clearAllCaches
methods.description: Clears all cache instances; primarily used for testing.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the cache with optional TTL.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key, updating its position in the FIFO queue if found.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated value from the cache.

methods.name: setMaxSizeOverride
methods.description: Overrides the maximum size for all cache instances.
